blocks.headline: Autofill job applications from your verified profile
blocks.lead: Stop typing the same work history into every form. SearchBreaker fills recurring fields from your verified profile, shows where each value came from and leaves the final review, and the submit button, to you.

blocks.heading: Where autofill works
blocks.emptyText: We test each application platform before listing it. Until then, SearchBreaker prepares your answers and you fill in the form yourself.
blocks.footnote: Platforms not listed here are not supported. Support can change when a platform updates its forms; we re-test and update the date.

blocks.heading: Autofill versus auto apply
blocks.lead: Both save time, but they differ in the one thing that matters most: who presses submit.

values.autofill: Fills application fields from your verified profile.
values.auto: Prepares and sends applications that match rules you set.
SearchBreaker, only under rules you approved. You can pause it at any time.

blocks.caption: Auto apply has its own page with the details.

faqs.a: No. Autofill fills fields and stops. You review the form and press submit yourself.

faqs.q: Will it fill sensitive fields incorrectly?
faqs.a: It only uses facts from your verified profile, and it leaves a field empty when there is no matching fact. Check sensitive fields yourself before submitting.

faqs.q: Does it support Workday, Greenhouse or Lever?
faqs.a: Support is listed only for platforms that have been tested, with the date of the last check. Until a platform is verified, it is not claimed.

faqs.q: What if a form fills incorrectly?
faqs.a: Correct the field or reject the value. Your correction is kept for that application, and your profile is not changed unless you choose to update it.
